title: 喧闹和富有
summary: richer[a,b] 表示 a 比 b 富有，返回对每个人而言不比其穷的人中最安静者编号。
insight: 建立从较穷者指向所有直接更富者的图；记忆化 DFS 的答案是自己与每个更富邻居答案中 quiet 值最小者。
pitfalls: 题目保证富有关系无环

solutions.title: 更富祖先记忆化 DFS
solutions.idea: 沿反向富有关系聚合最安静编号。
steps: dfs(person) 若已算返回；best=person，递归每个 rich，若 quiet[candidate]<quiet[best] 更新，缓存并返回

code.java: class Solution { private List<Integer>[] richerThan;private int[] quiet,answer;public int[] loudAndRich(int[][] richer,int[] quiet){int n=quiet.length;this.quiet=quiet;richerThan=new List[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)richerThan[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] relation:richer)richerThan[relation[1]].add(relation[0]);answer=new int[n];Arrays.fill(answer,-1);for(int person=0;person<n;person++)dfs(person);return answer;}private int dfs(int person){if(answer[person]>=0)return answer[person];int best=person;for(int rich:richerThan[person]){int candidate=dfs(rich);if(quiet[candidate]<quiet[best])best=candidate;}return answer[person]=best;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var richerThan:Array<MutableList<Int>>;private lateinit var quiet:IntArray;private lateinit var answer:IntArray;fun loudAndRich(richer:Array<IntArray>,quiet:IntArray):IntArray{this.quiet=quiet;richerThan=Array(quiet.size){mutableListOf()};for(relation in richer)richerThan[relation[1]].add(relation[0]);answer=IntArray(quiet.size){-1};for(person in quiet.indices)dfs(person);return answer};private fun dfs(person:Int):Int{if(answer[person]>=0)return answer[person];var best=person;for(rich in richerThan[person]){val candidate=dfs(rich);if(quiet[candidate]<quiet[best])best=candidate};answer[person]=best;return best} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<vector<int>> richerThan;vector<int> quiet,answer;int dfs(int person){if(answer[person]>=0)return answer[person];int best=person;for(int rich:richerThan[person]){int candidate=dfs(rich);if(quiet[candidate]<quiet[best])best=candidate;}return answer[person]=best;}public:vector<int> loudAndRich(vector<vector<int>>& richer,vector<int>& values){quiet=values;richerThan.assign(quiet.size(),{});for(auto& relation:richer)richerThan[relation[1]].push_back(relation[0]);answer.assign(quiet.size(),-1);for(int person=0;person<(int)quiet.size();++person)dfs(person);return answer;} };
